description_en: Suspends specified scaling processes in a scaling group
description_zh: 暂停伸缩组中的指定流程
kebab_example: aliyun ess suspend-processes --scaling-group-id asg-bp15oubotmrq11xe0000 --process ScaleIn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SuspendProcesses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request.
You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。
从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of scaling process to suspend. Valid values of N: 1 to 100. Valid values:
ScaleIn: scale-in process.
ScaleOut: scale-out process.
HealthCheck: health check.
AlarmNotification: event-triggered task.
ScheduledAction: scheduled task.

The system supports suspending the preceding five types of scaling processes. If you specify more than these five types, the system automatically removes duplicate types
parameters.help_zh:
需要暂停的活动类型，N的取值范围：1~100。取值范围：
ScaleIn：缩容流程。
ScaleOut：扩容流程。
HealthCheck：健康检查。
AlarmNotification：报警任务。
ScheduledAction：定时任务。

目前系统支持暂停以上5种活动类型，如果您指定的活动类型超过以上5种，系统会自动去掉重复的活动类型
parameters.name: process

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
